subject: How this production is built
decision: atelier composition on the ink-sketch playbook, not the 11-stage pipeline
rejected_because: skills/creative/ink-theater.md declares the style pipeline-exempt; the stock scene-type catalogue cannot express a 120-body simulation

subject: Composition runtime
rejected_because: remotion: the piece is 120 SVG bodies rewritten per frame from a typed array, which is DOM work, not React scene work. ffmpeg: no composition capability.

subject: Narration TTS provider
decision: Kokoro v1.0 am_michael, local ONNX, 24kHz, free
rejected_because: piper was the weakest component in productions 1-5 and Kokoro is already on this machine; am_michael measured 2.90 w/s on the audition line, the calmest of the male voices, with 0.42 of headroom

subject: Music and score
decision: self-produced: 17,121 claps synthesised in numpy from the simulation, plus a low pad whose amplitude is the Kuramoto order parameter
options_considered: a score synthesised from the simulation itself
rejected_because: a library or generated track would be playing alongside the argument; a pad driven by r IS the argument, and it costs nothing

subject: Images, video and stock
decision: none — every mark is drawn by the composition
rejected_because: user constraint: nothing paid, zero API keys
